scripts.postgres-init: mkdir -p "$PGHOST" "$(dirname "$PGDATA")"; if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ] || [ -z "$(ls -A "$PGDATA" 2>/dev/null || true)" ]; then initdb -D "$PGDATA" -A trust; fi
scripts.postgres-ensure: if pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; if [ -f "$PGDATA/postmaster.pid" ]; then if ! kill -0 $(head -n 1 "$PGDATA/postmaster.pid") 2>/dev/null; then rm "$PGDATA/postmaster.pid"; fi; fi; pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -l "$PGHOST/postgres.log" -o "-k $PGHOST -p $PGPORT" start || (tail -n 50 "$PGHOST/postgres.log"; exit 1); for i in $(seq 1 50); do pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; echo "Postgres did not become ready" >&2; tail -n 50 "$PGHOST/postgres.log"; exit 1
scripts.db:role: devbox run postgres-ensure && psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -d postgres -c "DO \$\$ BEGIN CREATE ROLE \"$PGUSER\" LOGIN CREATEDB; EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN END \$\$;"
scripts.db:prepare: devbox run postgres-ensure && bundle exec rails db:prepare && RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rails db:prepare
scripts.solr-init: mkdir -p "$SOLR_HOME" "$SOLR_LOGS_DIR" "$SOLR_PID_DIR"; SOLR_BIN_REAL=$(command -v solr); SOLR_DIST=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$SOLR_BIN_REAL")")"); if [ ! -f "$SOLR_HOME/solr.xml" ]; then cp "$SOLR_DIST/server/solr/solr.xml" "$SOLR_HOME/solr.xml"; fi; if [ ! -d "$SOLR_HOME/configsets" ]; then cp -R "$SOLR_DIST/server/solr/configsets" "$SOLR_HOME/configsets"; fi
scripts.solr-start: devbox run solr-init && bash -c 'OS=$(uname -s); EXTRA=""; if [ "$OS" != "Darwin" ]; then EXTRA="-XX:-UseContainerSupport"; fi; JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="$EXTRA" solr start -p "$SOLR_PORT" -s "$SOLR_HOME" -a "$SOLR_OPTS" 2>/dev/null || echo "Solr already running"'
scripts.solr-stop: bash -c 'OS=$(uname -s); EXTRA=""; if [ "$OS" != "Darwin" ]; then EXTRA="-XX:-UseContainerSupport"; fi; JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="$EXTRA" solr stop -p "$SOLR_PORT" || true'
scripts.solr-create-core: bash -c 'CORE="$SOLR_CORE"; CONF="$SOLR_CONF_DIR"; OS=$(uname -s); EXTRA=""; if [ "$OS" != "Darwin" ]; then EXTRA="-XX:-UseContainerSupport"; fi; if curl -fsS "http://$SOLR_HOST:$SOLR_PORT/solr/$CORE/admin/ping?wt=json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Core $CORE already exists"; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -d "$CONF" ]; then echo "Missing SOLR_CONF_DIR=$CONF" >&2; exit 1; fi; JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="$EXTRA" solr create -p "$SOLR_PORT" -s "$SOLR_HOME" -c "$CORE" -d "$CONF"'
scripts.server: devbox run postgres-ensure && bundle exec rails server -p ${PORT:-3000}
scripts.test: devbox run postgres-ensure && RAILS_ENV=test bundle exec rspec
